title: Friday the 13th
tagline: Camp Crystal Lake is open again. Bring your own cook.
about: A group of young counsellors arrive to reopen Camp Crystal Lake, a summer camp with a dark past, ignoring every warning from the locals.
cue: Serve the disco fries when Annie stops at the diner in town to ask the way to camp.
faces: The cook starts tomorrow. Until then you feed yourselves, and nobody goes down to the lake after dark.

sauce and pepper and simmer until smooth and thick.Pile the chips in a dish, scatter with mozzarella and ladle the hot gravy over.Lakeside grilled cornCharred sweetcorn with chilli lime butter, parmesan and corianderHow to make it60g butter, softened1 lime, zested and juiced1/2 tsp chilli powder1/2 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp salt4 corn cobs, husked and halved30g parmesan, finely grated2 tbsp coriander, choppedMash the butter with the lime zest and juice, chilli powder, paprika and salt.Boil the corn for 4 minutes.Char on a very hot grill or barbecue, turning.Brush with the butter and roll in parmesan and coriander.MainsAnnie's camp cook sloppy joesBeef mince in a sweet and tangy tomato sauce with onion and capsicum, on toasted soft rolls with picklesHow to make it750g beef mince1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp salt4 soft burger buns20g butter1/2 cup dill pickles, slicedBrown the mince in the oil, breaking it up.Add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft.Stir in the tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, sugar, mustard, vinegar, Worcestershire, chilli powder and salt and simmer until thick.Toast the buns in the butter.Pile in the filling and top with tbsp olive oil800g chat potatoes4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise2 spring onions, sliced1 cos lettucesalt and pepper, to tasteMarinate the chicken in the juice of 1 lemon, the garlic, oregano and 2 tbsp oil.Boil the potatoes until tender, cool a little and toss with the mayonnaise and spring onion.Grill the chicken over the coals until charred and cooked through.Dress the cos with the last of the oil and lemon and serve with the chicken and potatoes.SweetsCrystal Lake blueberry cobblerBlueberries baked under a buttery buttermilk biscuit crust, with vanilla ice creamHow to make it750g blueberries, fresh or frozen100g caster sugar, for the fruit1 lemon, zested and juiced1 tbsp cornflour200g self-raising flour50g caster sugar, for the topping1/4 tsp salt90g cold butter, cubed160ml buttermilk1 tbsp demerara sugar500ml vanilla ice creamHeat the oven to 190°C. Toss the blueberries with the sugar for the fruit, lemon zest and juice and cornflour in a 25cm ovenproof pan.Rub the butter into the flour, sugar for the topping and salt.Stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough.Dollop over the fruit and sprinkle with demerara sugar.Bake until golden and bubbling.Rest, then serve with the ice cream.DrinksCounsellors' cabin shandyCold lager topped with homemade lemonade, with lemon slicesHow to make it80g caster sugar80ml hot water4 lemons, juiced400ml soda water, chilled750ml lager, cold1 lemon, slicedStir the sugar into the hot water until dissolved, then cool.Mix the syrup with the lemon juice and soda water.Half fill four chilled glasses with lager, top with the lemonade and add a lemon slice.
